reviewMethod: Independent visual reading of all 20 question-paper pages and PDF pages 31–60 of the combined Foundation scheme, covering the complete Paper 2 section. Model answers and separate credit notes cross-checked against the summary on PDF page 48.
sourceNotes: Candidates answer Q1–7, either Q8A or Q8B, and both Q9 and Q10. Both finite alternative routes are retained: 325 offered marks, 300 candidate marks.
48 independently marked units. Q2(b)(ii–iv) shares one 5C scale; the three spinner probabilities each have their own 5C scale. Median and mode in Q3(b) share one 5C scale.
Both Q8A and Q8B are preserved as distinct printed question identities and each retains 25 marks. Q8A has three independently marked tasks; Q8B has four.
The question booklet is LC003BLP230EV.pdf. Its indexed scheme is LC003BLP000EV.pdf, shared with Paper 1. All references are PDF positions.

PDF page 47 mistakenly says Paper 1 in its heading. It follows Paper 2 model answers and precedes the Paper 2 summary and detailed notes; its bands differ from Paper 1: 5C = 0,2,4,5; 5D = 0,2,3,4,5; 10C = 0,5,7,10; 10D = 0,3,5,8,10.
Historical prompts map into the existing canonical Mathematics registry. The mathematics:2015 identifier does not imply this paper was sat under a later specification.
Q5(c), Q9(b) and Q10 continuations retain their original data and diagram pages. There is no physical length measurement in this booklet.

Topic Atlas uses the existing verified Q8 sidecar, which contains both alternatives on paper pages 12–13 and scheme pages 41–42. Their topic union is attached to that source question; Mark Bank retains separately selectable Q8A and Q8B tasks.
